text_block_list.text:
I beat you, you beat me not! I beat you,
you beat
me not!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп bests Тосэн Джордан with the
haughty
triumph of a child on the
playground! She also
gets a new clue, so
that's nice.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
They promise to have a rematch on a big
stage
next time. Meanwhile, the
organizer of the search
for Eden and the
clues remains unknown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
